abstract: Les outils d’IA générative peuvent aider les élèves à réaliser leurs devoirs plus rapidement et à obtenir de meilleurs résultats. Mais l’objectif n’est pas simplement d’accomplir ces tâches ; il s’agit avant tout d’apprendre grâce à elles. Cet article s’appuie sur des données concernant plus de 25 000 élèves de la 5e à la terminale en Chine pour examiner comment l’utilisation autonome de l’IA générative influe sur leur apprentissage. Le temps consacré aux devoirs par les élèves ayant utilisé l’IA a diminué et leurs notes aux devoirs ont augmenté, mais leurs notes aux examens ont baissé. Si l’effet initial est faible, il s’amplifie à mesure que les élèves maîtrisent mieux les outils d’IA et que la quantité de matière étudiée augmente après leur adoption, ce qui suggère que les études existantes, de courte durée, pourraient sous-estimer les coûts d’apprentissage à long terme liés à l’utilisation de l’IA générative.
authors: David Strömberg, Victor Lei, Yanhui Wu
title: La pénalité d'apprentissage liée à l'IA générative au collège et au lycée

abstract: We propose an exact linear programming (LP)-based solution approach to the Guaranteed Service Model (GSM), one of the most widely applied models for optimizing safety stock placement in supply chain networks. Our approach handles any directed acyclic network and any cost function that depends on a stage’s incoming and outgoing service times. It scales polynomially in the number of nodes n in the network, pseudo-polynomially with respect to the bit size of the maximum replenishment time M, and (for fixed M) exponentially in its treewidth, which quantifies how “tree-like” a network is and can be much smaller than n. This contrasts with existing approaches, which scale exponentially in n. The proof of exactness relies crucially on showing that the join of transportation-like polytopes remains integral and is more broadly applicable to other Operations Management problems. In addition to an exact formulation, our LP-based approach enables a practical solution strategy for the GSM built on a hierarchy of LP relaxations. These relaxations provide valid lower bounds, certify optimality when integral, and can strengthen existing exact methods. In our computational study, the smallest relaxation already recovers an optimal GSM solution on every real-world benchmark instance, leading to substantial speed-ups over the state-of-the-art exact algorithm and commercial general-purpose solvers. The framework also supports sensitivity analysis and accommodates additional operational constraints. Overall, our approach builds a new bridge between Operations Management and Computer Science, providing new theoretical foundations and practical tools for managing safety stocks in complex modern supply chain networks. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Funding: A. P. Calmon acknowledges financial support provided by the Ray C. Anderson Center for Sustainable Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.03155 .
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: From Trees to Treewidth: Inventory Management in Complex Supply Chain Networks

abstract: We study a game with a finite number of incumbent producers and a new agent that is storage; storage must buy to sell. We construct a novel equilibrium that is payoff-maximizing for the incumbents, in which they cooperate to prevent storage from operating even absent entry costs. Two kinds of deviations must be deterred: deviations by producers and deviations by storage. The producers achieve cooperation through the threat of Nash reversion and preempt operation of the storage unit with the threat to cycle between high purchase prices and low selling prices. The corresponding incentive constraints are summarized by a new, two-sided necessary condition on the discount factor. The essential feature of the equilibrium is that other players determine the marginal cost of storage. The motivating, but not exclusive, application is electricity markets.
title: Preemption equilibrium in a storage game

abstract: This paper revisits the exchange rate puzzle following contractionary monetary policy shocks in a small open economy. Using a Bayesian SVAR for Mexico, we compare three cumulative identification schemes: pure sign restrictions on impulse response functions (IRFs), a closed-economy Taylor-type rule with contemporaneous sign and zero restrictions, and an exchange-rate-augmented rule. Neither pure sign restrictions nor the closed-economy rule yields a precisely estimated overshooting pattern—only the augmented rule does. Robust to alternative specifications, these results suggest that omitting the exchange rate from the systematic component of monetary policy may hinder shock identification in small open economies.
title: The exchange rate puzzle and the systematic component of monetary policy: Evidence from Mexico

abstract: If the underlying data-generating process operates at a higher frequency than observed data, timing and dynamic restrictions in structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) may be misspecified. Building on Berger et al. (2020), I propose an alternative identification scheme that jointly relaxes the zero-impact restriction on realized volatility and the zero-lag restrictions on macroeconomic variables in the volatility block, estimated with a richer twelve-lag specification. Applied to euro area data, the identified shocks depress real activity gradually and with a delay, unlike the macro-neutral U.S. evidence, though they account for only a modest share of real fluctuations.
title: The macroeconomic effects of purely forward-looking uncertainty shocks: Evidence from the euro area

abstract: This paper experimentally studies how coordinated punishment can be misused. In a repeated trust game with public reputation, we compare a silent commitment treatment, where Agents privately choose a review threshold (the minimum payment required for a positive review), with a public commitment treatment, where the review threshold is observable before Principals choose payments. Public commitment significantly reduces cooperation: effort and payments fall relative to silent commitment. Public commitment also turns posted review thresholds into more enforceable demands: Principals are substantially more likely to meet visible thresholds. Successful zero-effort extraction, in which an Agent exerts no effort but sets a positive review threshold met by the Principal’s payment, is significantly more frequent under public commitment. Reputation systems can therefore discipline misconduct, but may also create tools for extortion.
title: Weaponized reputation: Experimental evidence on the misuse of coordinated punishments

abstract: This study examines whether Sustainable Rice Platform (SRP) practices in Thailand are driven by directional social peer exposure and physical proximity. Analysing survey data from 1363 rice‐producing households across Thailand's Central and Northeastern regions, we construct a directed social network based on self‐reported information exchanges alongside a spatial network grounded in shared subdistrict locations. Methodologically, the analysis transitions from probit specifications to Spatial Durbin Models that jointly account for spatial peer outcomes and covariates. The results show a robust positive association between the adoption behaviour of physically proximate peers and household SRP adoption. By contrast, the average peer effect in the pooled social network is not statistically significant. Once the social network is decomposed by direction, however, a significant positive peer effect emerges for inward ties—relationships from which farmers receive information—while outward ties remain insignificant. Program participation, irrigation access, and prior use of SRP‐related practices are also positively associated with adoption. These findings suggest that sustainable technology diffusion depends not simply on social connectedness, but on the directional flow of information and the visual observability of practices in physical space. By integrating spatial and directed social networks within a unified framework, this study underscores the critical role of directional heterogeneity in peer‐driven agricultural technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察泰国可持续水稻平台（SRP）实践是否由方向性社会同伴暴露与物理邻近性所驱动。通过分析来自泰国中部和东北部地区1363个水稻种植户的调查数据，我们构建了一个基于自我报告信息交流的有向社会网络，以及一个基于共同分区位置的空间网络。在方法上，分析从probit设定转向空间杜宾模型，该模型同时考虑空间同伴结果与协变量。结果表明，物理邻近同伴的采纳行为与农户SRP采纳之间存在稳健的正相关关系。相比之下，合并社会网络中的平均同伴效应在统计上不显著。然而，一旦按方向对社会网络进行分解，内向联系——即农户从中接收信息的关——呈现出显著的正向同伴效应，而外向联系仍不显著。项目参与、灌溉可及性以及此前对SRP相关实践的使用也与采纳呈正相关。这些发现表明，可持续技术扩散不仅取决于社会连通性，还取决于信息的方向性流动以及实践在物理空间中的视觉可观察性。通过在统一框架内整合空间网络与有向社会网络，本研究强调了方向性异质性在同伴驱动的农业技术采纳中的关键作用。
title: Directional Peer Effects in Technology Adoption: Influence of Farmer Interactions in Sustaining Rice Production in Thailand
title_zh: 技术采纳中的定向同伴效应：泰国农民互动对维持水稻生产的影响

abstract: How responsive is the location of economic activity to shocks? This paper uses a new data set on the location of factories in the Russian Empire (1890, 1908) and the Soviet Union (1989), supported by modern nightlight data, to explore the forces determining the spatial location of industrial production in Eurasia over the long twentieth century. Over this period, the region experienced a radical shift in its economic system from market to central planning and back again. Production was also subjected to various shocks, including war and the associated relocation of firms, forced population movement, and infrastructure investments. We assess to what extent these shocks changed the role of agglomeration effects, local labour inputs and market access in determining industry location. We find that shocks to labour fundamentals shifted the economy to new spatial equilibria. Nonetheless, the shifts were small in magnitude and these forces were not powerful enough to eradicate the path-dependent effects of Tsarist locations that were still evident in the industrial structure of the region even a century later. These results suggest the impact of even severe shocks to a spatial equilibrium to be modest at the aggregate level.
abstract_zh: 经济活动的区位对冲击的响应程度如何？本文利用关于俄罗斯帝国（1890年、1908年）和苏联（1989年）工厂区位的新数据集，并以现代夜间灯光数据为支撑，探讨在漫长的20世纪中决定欧亚大陆工业生产空间区位的力量。在此期间，该地区的经济体制经历了从市场到中央计划再回到市场的根本性转变。生产还受到各种冲击的影响，包括战争及相关的企业迁移、强制人口流动和基础设施投资。我们评估这些冲击在多大程度上改变了集聚效应、本地劳动投入和市场准入在决定产业区位中的作用。我们发现，对劳动基本面的冲击使经济转向新的空间均衡。尽管如此，这些转变幅度较小，且这些力量不足以消除沙皇时期区位的路径依赖效应——即使在一个世纪之后，这种效应在该地区的工业结构中仍然显而易见。这些结果表明，即使是对空间均衡的严重冲击，其总体层面的影响也是温和的。
title: The industrial geography of Eurasia in the 20th century: Soviet planners meet Tsarist fundamentals
title_zh: 20世纪欧亚大陆的工业地理：苏联规划者与沙俄基础的相遇

abstract: This paper examines the impact of ride-hailing platforms on entrepreneurship by exploiting the staggered rollout of Didi, China’s dominant ride-hailing service, across cities. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that platform entry increases per capita new business registrations. Mechanism analyses show that improved consumption convenience and expanded market access are the primary drivers, whereas income smoothing and failure protection play little role. These findings highlight substantial economic spillovers from digital platforms beyond their immediate markets and underscore the potential of digital infrastructure investments to foster entrepreneurship in developing economies. KEYWORDS: Developing economies entrepreneurship market expansion ride-hailing platforms JEL CLASSIFICATION: L26 R41 L86 Acknowledgements We thank Yanke Dai, Xiang Zuo, and Yangfei Xu for their constructive suggestions. We thank the editor and anonymous referees for their valuable comments and suggestions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过利用滴滴——中国占主导地位的网约车服务——在各城市交错推出的特点，考察网约车平台对创业的影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现平台进入提高了人均新企业注册量。机制分析表明，消费便利性的改善和市场准入的扩大是主要驱动因素，而收入平滑和失败保护的作用甚微。这些发现凸显了数字平台在其直接市场之外产生的显著经济溢出效应，并强调了数字基础设施投资在发展中经济体促进创业的潜力。关键词：发展中经济体 创业 市场扩张 网约车平台 JEL分类：L26 R41 L86 致谢 我们感谢戴延科、左翔和徐扬飞提出的建设性建议。我们感谢编辑和匿名审稿人提出的宝贵意见和建议。

title: From rides to startups: the entrepreneurial impact of ride-hailing platforms

abstract: Based on the empirical study using convex nonparametric least squares (CNLS) with a within estimator for panel data analysis, this research examines the impact of supply chain finance (SCF) on blockchain enterprise operational performance. The methodology mitigates over-parameterization by assigning unique shadow prices to each firm, enhancing interpretability. Results reveal significant industry heterogeneity: SCF substantially improves operational performance in the application software and information technology consulting sectors, where financing constraints are acute. This positive effect is primarily driven by the use of notes payable rather than short-term loans, reflecting the varying accessibility and suitability of different SCF instruments. Conversely, internet software and electronic equipment firms exhibit negligible responsiveness, attributed to alternative financing access (e.g. equity, policy-backed loans) or misaligned SCF instrument terms. The study underscores the context-dependent efficacy of blockchain enterprises SCF, advocating tailored implementation to alleviate SME financing bottlenecks and optimize supply chain resilience. Policy and managerial emphasis should prioritize user-centric blockchain solutions to amplify operational gains. KEYWORDS: Supply chain management blockchain operational research financial management convex nonparametric least squares JEL CLASSIFICATION: G32 O33 C23
abstract_zh: 基于凸非参数最小二乘法（CNLS）并结合面板数据分析中的组内估计量进行的实证研究，本文考察了供应链金融（SCF）对区块链企业运营绩效的影响。该方法通过为每家企业赋予独特的影子价格，缓解了过度参数化问题，并增强了可解释性。结果表明存在显著的行业异质性：在融资约束较为严峻的应用软件和信息技术咨询行业，SCF显著提升了运营绩效。这一正向效应主要由应付票据的使用而非短期贷款驱动，反映出不同SCF工具在可及性和适用性上的差异。相反，互联网软件和电子设备企业则表现出可忽略的响应性，这归因于其拥有替代性融资渠道（如股权融资、政策支持贷款）或SCF工具条款不匹配。本研究强调了区块链企业SCF efficacy的情境依赖性，主张通过定制化实施来缓解中小企业融资瓶颈并优化供应链韧性。政策和管理层面的重点应优先放在以用户为中心的区块链解决方案上，以放大运营收益。关键词：供应链管理 区块链 运营研究 财务管理 凸非参数最小二乘法 JEL分类：G32 O33 C23

abstract: By utilizing detailed data on wealth management products (WMPs) disclosed after the promulgation of the New Asset Management Regulation (NAMR), we empirically investigate the impact and transmission channels of deposit market power on excess returns of WMPs in China, and two main conclusions are drawn. First, banks’ deposit market power is significantly and positively correlated with excess returns of WMPs. Second, this relationship is mainly transmitted through two pathways, banks’ risk-taking measured by Z-score and banks’ net interest margin (NIM). Despite the result that deposit-side market power affects the performance of WMPs, further analyses reveal that the overall market power of banks exerts positive yet insignificant effect on excess returns of WMPs. Our study offers a new perspective to understand the underlying role of institutional market power. The results indicate that banks with stronger deposit market power tend to launch WMPs more appealing to investors. We fill a long-standing research gap regarding micro-level channels between market power and WMPs’ performance, thus carry crucial theoretical and practical implications. KEYWORDS: Shadow banking wealth management products market power risk-taking JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G23 G28
abstract_zh: 本文利用《新资产管理条例》（NAMR）颁布后披露的理财产品（WMPs）详细数据，实证研究了存款市场势力对中国理财产品超额收益的影响及其传导渠道，并得出两个主要结论。第一，银行存款市场势力与理财产品超额收益显著正相关。第二，这一关系主要通过两条路径传导，即以Z值衡量的银行风险承担和银行净息差（NIM）。尽管存款端市场势力会影响理财产品绩效，但进一步分析表明，银行整体市场势力对理财产品超额收益具有正向但不显著的影响。本研究为理解制度性市场势力的潜在作用提供了新视角。结果表明，存款市场势力更强的银行倾向于发行对投资者更具吸引力的理财产品。我们填补了关于市场势力与理财产品绩效之间微观层面渠道的长期研究空白，因而具有重要的理论与实践意义。关键词：影子银行 理财产品 市场势力 风险承担 JEL分类：G21 G23 G28

title: The impact of institutional market power on excess returns of wealth management products in China

abstract: We examine strongly symmetric equilibrium (SSE) payoff sets in a general repeated Cournot oligopoly. In a seminal paper, Abreu (1986) shows that the entire set of SSE payoffs can be constructed through simple two-phase (“stick-and-carrot”) punishment paths. However, we find that for many commonly used demand functions, the resulting SSE payoff set can be non-convex, and the quantities and payoffs associated with the best and worst SSEs can exhibit discontinuities in the discount factor. To resolve these issues, we propose regularity conditions that prevent such anomalies in SSE payoffs. Beyond our baseline model, we demonstrate that similar anomalies also arise in other important applications of Abreu’s optimal symmetric punishments in the literature. Our findings highlight the need for caution when applying stick-and-carrot punishments in collusion analysis across different scenarios.
abstract_zh: 我们考察一般重复古诺寡头博弈中的强对称均衡（SSE）收益集。在一篇开创性论文中，Abreu（1986）表明，整个SSE收益集可以通过简单的两阶段（“大棒—胡萝卜”）惩罚路径构造出来。然而，我们发现，对于许多常用的需求函数，由此得到的SSE收益集可能是非凸的，并且与最优和最差SSE相关的产量和收益在贴现因子中可能表现出不连续性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一些正则性条件，以防止SSE收益中出现此类异常。在基准模型之外，我们进一步表明，在文献中Abreu最优对称惩罚的其他重要应用中，类似的异常也会出现。我们的发现凸显出，在不同情形下将大棒—胡萝卜惩罚应用于合谋分析时需要谨慎。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Anomalies in strongly symmetric equilibria of repeated Cournot oligopolies
title_zh: 重复古诺寡头垄断强对称均衡中的异常现象

abstract: This paper studies the relationship between subjective expectations and the term structure of interest rates. Departing from rational expectations, we allow market participants to hold arbitrary beliefs about future interest rates, and derive the condition that expected and realized interest rates must satisfy irrespective of how expectations are formed. We use this condition to decompose the sensitivity of long-term yields to the short-term interest rate into contributions from expectations and risk premia, without imposing any assumption on expectation formation. We find that, for short and medium-maturity bonds, this sensitivity is driven primarily by movements in expectations rather than risk premia. We then study the sensitivity of expectations themselves and document systematic wedges between the response of long-term yield expectations and that of expectations of shorter maturity yields over the same window. We argue that these wedges reflect structural inconsistency in subjective expectations, in the sense that expectations across maturities and forecast horizons are inconsistent with the equilibrium restrictions that link different interest rates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究主观预期与利率期限结构之间的关系。我们偏离理性预期，允许市场参与者对未来利率持有任意信念，并推导出无论预期如何形成，预期利率与实际利率都必须满足的条件。我们利用这一条件，将长期收益率对短期利率的敏感性分解为预期与风险溢价的贡献，而不对预期形成施加任何假设。我们发现，对于短期和中期债券，这种敏感性主要由预期的变动而非风险溢价驱动。随后，我们研究预期本身的敏感性，并记录了在同一窗口内，长期收益率预期的响应与较短期限收益率预期的响应之间存在系统性楔子。我们认为，这些楔子反映了主观预期中的结构性不一致，即不同期限和预测期限的预期与连接不同利率的均衡约束不相容。
title: Expectations and the Term Structure of Interest Rates
title_zh: 预期与利率期限结构

abstract: Owing to the confined area, clear spatial boundaries, and heterogeneous characteristics, islands serve as ideal natural laboratories for developing territorial spatial planning techniques. This study addresses the disconnection between ecosystem-based assessments and practical planning across China's 12 major island counties. We established fine-resolution (100 m × 100 m) models of island ecological resilience and development suitability based on element couplings. Results revealed significant national-scale spatial heterogeneity: ecological resilience is predominantly influenced by human activities, a dominant role demonstrated here for the first time at this scale, while development suitability is primarily controlled by soil, topography, and coastline proximity. These models informed three multi-scenario conservation zonings and five region-specific functional zonings, whose integration generated 15 planning schemes dividing the study area into core conservation, buffer conservation, permanent farmland, urban development, and integrated development zones. Theoretically, we demonstrate that element couplings exhibit systematic spatial heterogeneity and that aggregation scale directly influences planning outcomes, establishing region-specific parameterization as a necessity. Methodologically, the "realism and orientation" principles bridge technical assessment and implementation by embedding feasibility and strategic direction as explicit selection criteria. Guided by these principles, we selected optimal solutions for each county. We further identified four development orientations, namely, nature conservation, agricultural production, urban development, and integrated multifunction, for 209 individual islands and the 12 counties, and proposed management strategies aligned with China's "Three Zones and Three Lines" framework. Beyond China, the study offers three actionable insights for island regions worldwide: regulating human activity intensity as the primary driver of ecological resilience, adopting region-specific planning within national frameworks, and complementing technical zoning with integrated management strategies . The findings validate that multi-scenario and region-specific techniques effectively balance ecological assessments with societal needs, bridging research and practice in spatial planning. This framework is transferable to other archipelagic regions and to any context where spatial heterogeneity of coupling parameters is significant.

abstract: Rising prices associated with numerous societal shocks in the 2020s have placed a financial burden on many households. One consequence has been the reduced ability for households to afford staples such as food, with growing evidence that food insecurity is increasing. Addressing such insecurity requires effective policy responses, including both targeted support for vulnerable individuals and place-based interventions aimed at struggling neighbourhoods. If the latter approach is adopted, robust measures of neighbourhood food insecurity are required to efficiently target local policy interventions and assess the effectiveness of national policies. This study reports the results of the application of a small area estimation technique, spatial microsimulation, to provide neighbourhood scale estimates of the percentage of adults that self-report as food insecure. The technique combines data that provides a detailed picture of the generic nature of a neighbourhood and survey data that is specifically concerned with food and dietary experiences to produce these estimates. A comparison of these direct estimates of food insecure adults with both proxy food security and general-purpose indicators of deprivation shows good agreement. The study concludes that if an area-based approach to tackling food insecurity is preferred to a more complex individually targeted approach, general-purpose indicators provide a robust basis for identifying neighbourhoods where policy interventions should be prioritised.
title: Producing neighbourhood estimates of food insecurity for England and Wales
title_zh: 为英格兰和威尔士生成社区粮食不安全估计

abstract: Sanctions have long been widely used as political and economic tools, especially in recent years. While existing studies have examined the impact of sanctions on trade, product heterogeneity is often overlooked. Using data from the Global Sanctions Database, BACI Database, and other relevant sources, this paper investigates how sanctions differentially affect the exports of products with varying comparative advantages in sanctioned countries, based on bilateral export data from 1995 to 2019. The findings reveal that although sanctions generally reduce overall exports from sanctioned countries, products with comparative advantages are more resilient to adverse impacts and may even experience an increase in exports. Further analysis indicates that the effects of sanctions on exports are influenced by factors such as the type of sanctions, bilateral political relations, and product‐level trade complementarity. Mechanism analysis shows that sanctions increase trade costs and economic uncertainty in sanctioned countries, but comparatively advantaged products are more resilient to sanction shocks. This study highlights the heterogeneous effects of sanctions on product‐level exports in sanctioned countries, providing more precise and comprehensive theoretical and empirical references for trade policy formulation and corporate export strategies.

abstract: Since 2012, the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program has provided temporary relief from deportation and a work permit for undocumented youth. In recent years, DACA renewals have faced slower processing, mounting legal challenges, and the ongoing risk of revocation. We present a novel imputation for immigrant status, which identifies likely DACA recipients, and provide estimates of the income losses stemming from the potential elimination of the program. Because recipients are young, current earnings understate their lifetime contribution to the U.S. economy; our estimates account for this, and for uncertainty around key calibration parameters. We estimate that losing work authorization could lower the earnings of the average DACA recipient by nearly $$\$9900$$ $ 9900 annually, or $$\$5.3$$ $ 5.3 billion for the approximately 540,000 recipients in 2023. Incorporating a likely feasible volume of removals, affecting half of the DACA-eligible population, raises annual losses to $$\$48,000$$ $ 48 , 000 per recipient and $$\$23.0$$ $ 23.0 billion in the aggregate. Lifetime losses in such a scenario reach $$\$260$$ $ 260 billion nationwide ( $$\$544,000$$ $ 544 , 000 per affected individual).
title: Shattered dreams: the economic impact of eliminating DACA
title_zh: 破碎的梦想：废除DACA的经济影响

abstract: We examine how corporate misconduct affects merger and acquisition (M&A) activity of non-prosecuted peer firms. We find that exposure to peer misconduct increases the propensity to participate in M&A transactions, both as an acquirer and as a target. Firms exposed to peer misconduct experience adverse financial and valuation pressures, creating opportunities for financially stronger firms to acquire distressed rivals at discounted prices. We show that acquisitions involving targets exposed to peer misconduct are characterized by lower takeover premiums, a higher fraction of stock payment, higher acquirer announcement returns, and greater deal synergies. Overall, the evidence supports the view that misconduct spillovers disproportionately affect targets through heightened regulatory pressures and compliance costs, shifting bargaining power toward acquirers in M&A transactions.
title: When a rival stumbles: Misconduct spillovers as an acquisition catalyst
title_zh: 当竞争对手失足：不当行为溢出效应作为收购催化剂

abstract: This paper shows that promotion incentives for county-level cadres in China are an important driver of air pollution deterioration. Building on the multi-winner tournament model proposed by Clark and Riis (1998), we predict an inverted-U-shaped relationship between the number of counties within a prefecture and the promotion incentives for county-level cadres. Using the length of small rivers as an instrumental variable for the number of counties within a prefecture, our empirical analysis identifies a robust inverted-U-shaped relationship between the number of counties and air pollution levels, suggesting that promotion incentives significantly exacerbate air pollution. Further analysis reveals that, in pursuit of economic growth, local cadres tend to relax environmental regulations and attract more pollution-intensive firms. In regions where cadres’ performance evaluation places less emphasis on economic growth, the inverted-U-shaped relationship does not exist. These findings suggest that local cadres’ career incentives stimulate economic growth at the expense of the environment.

abstract: This paper studies the aggregation of heterogeneous individual discount functions into a social discount function. Under the classical Pareto condition, time-additive preferences imply constant-weight aggregation, which severely restricts the form of social discounting and may conflict with time consistency. We show that weakening the Pareto requirement to comparisons between consumption streams that differ at only two periods leads to a broader class of admissible social discount functions, characterized as time-dependent weighted averages of individual discount functions. Stronger axioms further restrict this class and yield familiar methods such as the maximum discount function and exponential social discounting. The results provide an axiomatic foundation for social discounting in the presence of heterogeneous intertemporal preferences.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Time-dependent aggregation in social discounting
title_zh: 社会贴现中的时间依赖聚合

abstract: We estimate the effect of energy poverty on a range of subjective and objective health outcomes among older Europeans using ex-ante harmonized microdata from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe. To address potential endogeneity concerns, we exploit regional weather-based Eurostat data on Heating Degree Days to construct two instrumental variables for energy poverty. Our findings indicate that energy poverty has detrimental effects on both physical and mental health. Ordinary Least Squares estimates show that individuals experiencing energy poverty are more likely to report poor health, chronic lung conditions, and score higher on assessments of depressive symptoms and cognitive decline, while also displaying lower grip strength and a higher probability of sarcopenia. Instrumental variable estimates confirm a clinically significant negative effect on physical health, with energy poverty substantially reducing grip strength among older individuals. From a policy perspective, our results highlight the importance of integrating energy affordability into climate and decarbonization strategies. Policies that increase residential energy costs without adequate compensatory measures may unintentionally worsen heating deprivation and generate adverse health consequences, particularly within ageing societies. title: Energy poverty and health: Evidence from European countries

abstract: We prove the existence of a competitive equilibrium in an exchange economy with incomplete markets, where preferences may be discontinuous, non-ordered, price-dependent, and interdependent (externalities allowed), and no survival or interiority of the initial endowments assumption is imposed. Thus, we bring the existence of an equilibrium with incomplete asset markets to the “state of the art” level.
title: Incomplete markets with discontinuous preferences.
title_zh: 不完全市场中的不连续偏好。

abstract: Using a two-country model, this paper shows that the shift from foreign currency to local currency external borrowing does not eliminate the vulnerability of EMs to foreign financial shocks but instead results in “original sin redux.” A monetary tightening abroad is propagated to EM financial conditions through a tightening of foreign lenders’ financial constraints, driven in part by currency mismatches on their balance sheets. Foreign exchange intervention and capital flow management measures can mitigate global financial spillovers to EMs in the short run and a larger domestic investor base can reduce the vulnerability in the longer run.
title: Original sin redux: A model-based evaluation
title_zh: 原罪再现：基于模型的评估

abstract: Extreme sports like solo rock climbing and BASE jumping are experiencing a boom in popularity, yet we are only starting to understand why they attract people. Individuals’ decisions to engage in these risky activities has long posed a challenge for utility theory. Contrary to public perception, most adventure sport participants are not reckless or solely motivated by adrenaline rush. They are disciplined, investing years of intensive training to understand the environment in which they operate and to develop the skills necessary to master the risky challenges. In this paper we develop a theory that distinguishes between the endogenous risk inherent to the sport and determined by participants’ own choices, and exogenous or uncontrollable background risk. It is well documented that while inherent risk lures individuals to these extreme sports, participants fear uncontrollable dangers as much as anybody else. This allows us to decompose participants’ utility into the thrill component of the activity and other aspects of the sport such as exercise and time outdoors. The same framework delivers a value of statistical life (VSL) that is risk-type dependent. Because participants weigh safety against the activity’s inherent risk, VSL is identified by their marginal spending on self-protection rather than by the level of risk they accept, so their tolerance for controllable risk does not imply that they value life cheaply. With this decomposition at hand, we study the optimal allocation of risk between participants and providers of these sports. We show that the modern legal doctrine of assumption of risk, in which providers are liable for their own negligence, but not for accidents stemming from the inherent riskiness of the activity, is more efficient than alternative arrangements. We illustrate our results with a calibrated example.
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Where’s the fun in that? On thrill and liability in extreme sports
title_zh: 那有什么乐趣？论极限运动中的刺激与责任

abstract: Globalisation and industrialisation have over time generated profound changes in the agrifood system, producing multiple effects with strong spatial characteristics. These include de-territorialisation, accompanied by standardisation, specialisation and intensification. These processes have often determined significant impacts on rural territories and communities, due to the primacy of specific economic interests over the priorities of local socio-ecological systems. As a reaction to these dynamics, new paths have emerged, oriented to food re-localisation and sustainability transition and, more generally, seeking a more democratic approach in governing food systems and local development. Transitions of territorial agrifood systems indeed become the outcome of complex interaction dynamics established among different, multi-scale networks, reflecting their respective visions, objectives and power. Against such a background, this paper aims to contribute to the understanding of the transformations of specific territorial agrifood systems, marked by tensions between global forces and local dynamics. To that end it applies an analytical framework interrelating actors’ role and interactions, discursive components, and policies and governance issues. Focusing on the rural area of Tuscia (Italy), it analyses the expansion of the problematic hazelnut production. Tracing the long-term evolution of the territorial agrifood system and of governance dynamics, it reflects on the critical issues associated with the presence of global-scale economic activities in specific territorial contexts, and on the challenges faced by sustainable, locally tailored and community-driven development trajectories. The analysis helps deepen understanding of these processes and provides significant insights for the scientific debate, policy-makers and social groups involved in this type of process.
title: The evolution of territorial agrifood systems between global and local dynamics: Insights from hazelnut production in Tuscia (Italy)
title_zh: 地域农业食品系统在全球与地方动态之间的演变：来自意大利图西亚榛子生产的洞见

abstract: We propose a novel identification strategy to estimate the long-term imprinting effects of being born in the Great Recession on innovative startups. After purging ubiquitous selection biases and sorting effects, we find that recession startups experience substantially better long-term outcomes in terms of survival and growth in employment and sales, despite being born when funding is scarce and demand is declining. In contrast to prior work, we find that the recession does not encourage entry into entrepreneurship as job prospects dim; instead, it discourages exit by critical R&D workers who help recession startups out-innovate and out-perform expansion startups.
title: Great Recession babies: How are startups shaped by macro conditions at birth?
title_zh: 大衰退婴儿：初创企业如何受出生时宏观条件的影响？

abstract: This paper investigates how tax incentives for high-skill immigrants affect productivity. I collect data covering 90 percent of Italian faculty between 2000 and 2020 and use it to evaluate a 2004 tax break offering a temporary 90 percent reduction in taxable income for researchers. First, the evidence is consistent with the program attracting substantial return migration and positive selection of beneficiaries. Second, among groups that make an eligible hire, I find evidence consistent with higher-productivity hires significantly increasing their academic group’s average productivity, roughly split between their direct contribution and indirect responses of local faculty. Third, this indirect effect is largely explained by higher-productivity local researchers sorting into the treated group, rather than by productivity spillovers on incumbent researchers. An instrumental variable strategy based on perfect assortative matching corroborates the main findings.
title: ‘Returning brains’: Tax incentives, migration, and scientific productivity
title_zh: 回流人才”：税收激励、移民与科学产出

abstract: US Treasuries remain the world’s dominant reserve asset, but geopolitical risks can change how central banks assess the trade-off between liquidity and protection from foreign jurisdictions. This column argues that geopolitical risk can increase the demand for gold relative to sanctionable sovereign assets, putting upward pressure on the gold price and sovereign bond yields. It finds evidence of active portfolio adjustment consistent with this mechanism and shows that the adjustment is stronger in countries less aligned with the US. The results suggest that geopolitical considerations are becoming increasingly relevant alongside the traditional financial determinants of reserve allocation.
authors: Kai Arvai, Nuno Coimbra, Marco Pinchetti
title: Fool’s gold: How geopolitical risk is taking some of the shine off the US dollar
title_zh: 黄铁矿：地缘政治风险如何令美元失色

abstract: The labour force participation of women in the US peaked in 1997 and has stagnated since. This column argues that workplace inflexibility is the common thread running through this puzzle, using COVID-19 as a natural experiment. Women were hit harder than men in the initial downturn due to both over-representation in high-contact and inflexible service occupations and school closures. When remote work relaxed flexibility constraints, mothers’ employment rebounded strongly above pre-pandemic levels. But as return-to-office mandates have intensified, occupational inflexibility has re-emerged as a significant predictor of employment declines – and only for women.
title: Inflexibility and the stalled progress of American women in the labour market
title_zh: 美国女性在劳动力市场中的僵化与进展停滞

abstract: Educational attainment among adolescent girls in Nigeria remains low, particularly in the northern states where early marriage and limited schooling constrain women's economic opportunities. This study evaluates whether school-based life skills training delivered in safe spaces within senior secondary schools, alone or combined with digital literacy training, can improve educational, health, and economic outcomes for adolescent girls in northern Nigeria. Twelve months post-intervention, girls in treated schools show modest improvements in curriculum-related knowledge, with no effects on school retention or socio-emotional skills. Adding digital literacy training improved digital skills in the state where it had been fully implemented by midline, underscoring the role of implementation fidelity. These findings highlight both the promise and limitations of integrated school-based interventions and underscore the importance of delivery capacity for scaling technology-based programs in low-resource settings.
abstract_zh: 尼日利亚青春期女孩的受教育程度仍然较低，尤其是在北部各州，早婚和受教育机会有限制约了女性的经济机会。本研究评估在尼日利亚北部高中校园安全空间内开展的校本生活技能培训，单独实施或与数字素养培训相结合，能否改善青春期女孩的教育、健康和经济成果。干预后12个月，受干预学校的女孩在课程相关知识方面表现出适度改善，但对学业保留率或社会情感技能没有影响。在中期已全面实施数字素养培训的州，增加数字素养培训改善了数字技能，凸显了实施保真度的作用。这些发现既凸显了综合性校本干预的前景，也揭示了其局限性，并强调了在资源匮乏环境中推广基于技术的项目时交付能力的重要性。

abstract: Concerned about the low academic ability of teachers, in the 1990s and 2000s, some states increased occupational licensing stringency to weed out low-academic-ability candidates, while others decreased restrictions in hopes of attracting more competitive candidates, with states differing in the nature of their requirements. Studying 1991– 2007, we show that academic coursework requirements constitute the most prominent changes in licensing requirements and that stricter requirements increased the left tail of the distribution of college selectivity among secondary school teachers. We find no evidence of disparate negative effects for high-poverty school districts but some evidence for high-minority districts.
title: The Effects of Occupational Licensing Stringency on the Market for Public School Teachers

abstract: Existing evidence suggests that wealth may decline before dementia onset, but the mechanisms underlying these reductions are poorly understood. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study, we compare household finance trajectories for individuals who later develop dementia and those who do not. We find that wealth divergence between the two groups is not explained by reduced earnings, higher healthcare spending, intentional “spend-down” to qualify for Medicaid coverage, state-dependent utility, or reverse causation by which wealth declines cause dementia. Instead, our results point to impaired financial decision-making beginning about six years prior to clinically recognizable dementia.
title: Dementia and Long-Run Trajectories in Household Finances

abstract: Disagreement among researchers is a central and productive feature of scientific progress. Yet researchers’ incentives and behaviors, some only partly visible to readers, may affect empirical results. When these sources of variation affect estimates, standard errors may understate uncertainty. This paper synthesizes evidence on how researcher variation shapes empirical conclusions and presents new evidence on its sources and implications. We report results from a many-analyst study in which 146 research teams estimate the same causal effect under varying constraints. Although central estimates are broadly aligned, dispersion remains substantial. Imposing a shared research design reduced agreement, partly due to adherence errors. Further restricting data cleaning and preparation improved agreement. Variation across researchers is often comparable in magnitude to sampling uncertainty but is unevenly distributed across stages of the research process. Overall, the evidence suggests that conventional uncertainty summaries understate total uncertainty and that less visible research decisions warrant greater scrutiny.
abstract_zh: 研究者之间的分歧是科学进步的一个核心且富有成效的特征。然而，研究者的激励与行为——其中一些仅部分为读者所见——可能影响实证结果。当这些变异来源影响估计时，标准误可能低估不确定性。本文综合了关于研究者变异如何塑造实证结论的证据，并提供了关于其来源与含义的新证据。我们报告了一项多分析师研究的结果，其中146个研究团队在不同约束下估计同一因果效应。尽管中心估计大体一致，离散程度仍然相当大。施加共同的研究设计反而降低了共识，部分原因是遵循错误。进一步限制数据清洗与准备则改善了共识。研究者之间的变异在幅度上往往与抽样不确定性相当，但在研究过程的不同阶段分布不均。总体而言，证据表明，传统的不确定性汇总低估了总体不确定性，而较不显眼的研究决策值得更严格的审视。
title: The Sources of Researcher Variation in Economics
title_zh: 经济学中研究者差异的来源
